verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs mention an 'agent-powered spending analysis' use case for Financial Connections and Stripe's general MCP server lets AI agents call the Stripe API, implying some natural-language operability, but there's no detailed documentation of specific natural-language commands or agent workflows scoped to Financial Connections itself. Missing for 10: concrete examples of NL commands/agent interactions specific to Financial Connections, independent/hands-on validation that agents can operate this product conversationally, and clarity on how much of the flow (bank auth, consent) can be agent-driven vs. requiring a human UI step.
